- client: copilot-chat
  dates:
    due: "2026-02-15"
  description: "Goal for Single File Repo. \"Single file\" means one file per semantic/domain component — a \U0001F980️component.rs, a topic module — not one file per crate, and not collapsing an intentionally-split module tree back into a single lib.rs. --- SCOPE NOTE (amended 2026-08-05, ticket 26/08/05/SINGLE-FILE-REPO-GOAL-RESCOPE-AND-HAZARD-DOCUMENTATION, see also master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE): files under ✏️s/\U0001F50C️plugins/**/\U0001F5FF️artifacts, \U0001F39B️apps, \U0001F3AD️modes, \U0001FA9F️windows, \U0001F371️panes, \U0001FA80️widgets, \U0001FA9B️utilities, \U0001F3AC️actions, \U0001F39A️options, \U0001F4CC️panels, \U0001F3AE️commands, \U0001F6E0️tools taxonomy directories, and consolidated-framework-crate module files (\U0001F980️<name>.rs wired via #[path] from a crate-root \U0001F4E6️lib.rs), are OUT OF SCOPE for single-file consolidation and MUST NOT be inlined back into their parent lib.rs or module file. These are already \"single file\" at the correct grain (one file per component); merging them regresses the taxonomy, not simplifies it. --- SCOPE NOTE 2 (amended 2026-08-05, ticket 26/08/05/UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE): the same exclusion extends to every language, not just Rust. Any file matching a `\U0001F523️taxonomy.json` `taxonomyLeafFilenames` value (\U0001F980️component.rs, \U0001F7E6️component.tsx, \U0001F40D️component.py, \U0001F537️component.cs) under a `\U0001F9F1️elements/<Element>/` co-location directory, its wiring-only entry file (`\U0001F4E6️lib.rs` #[path] tree or `\U0001F4E6️index.tsx` re-export barrel) under `<owner>/\U0001F4E6️packages/<lang>/\U0001F3AF️targets/<target>/` or `<owner>/\U0001F4E6️packages/<lang>/`, its co-located `\U0001F9EA️story.tsx`, and target-dir `\U0001F980️<name>.rs` module files under `\U0001F9F0️framework/**/\U0001F4E6️packages/**`, are OUT OF SCOPE and MUST NOT be inlined back into their entry barrel/lib.rs — same reasoning as Scope Note 1, applied to the TypeScript-side split (e.g. `\U0001F5B1️ui`'s per-element `\U0001F7E6️component.tsx` files extracted from the former monolithic `\U0001F4E6️index.tsx`). This does not sanction leaving a split half-finished: the owning ticket's own agent re-inlining ITS OWN failed/aborted extraction (to keep the tree compile-green) remains allowed — only a THIRD PARTY consolidation pass merging an already-completed split is forbidden. This scope note does not close or supersede the goal — it clarifies what \"single file\" is measured against."
  github:
    issue: https://github.com/usalu/semio/issues/405
  llm: gemini-3-pro
  parent: "\U0001F3AFaioptimizedrepo"
  prompt: "Instructions for Single File Repo. \"Single file\" for this repo is a per-semantic-component target, not a per-crate or per-plugin target: fold accidental/incidental file splits (leftover scratch files, near-duplicate helpers, historical one-off scripts) into their single natural home, but never merge intentionally-split #[path] module trees. --- EXCLUSIONS (amended 2026-08-05): before inlining any #[path]-attributed .rs file into a parent lib.rs or component file, check whether it sits under a ✏️s/\U0001F50C️plugins/<plugin>/ taxonomy directory (\U0001F5FF️artifacts/\U0001F53A️diff, \U0001F5E3️dsl, \U0001F392️pack, \U0001F527️op, \U0001F4E1️spr, ⚙️engine; \U0001F39B️apps/.../\U0001F3AD️modes/.../\U0001FA9F️windows/.../\U0001F371️panes|\U0001FA80️widgets|\U0001FA9B️utilities|\U0001F3AC️actions|\U0001F39A️options; \U0001F4CC️panels; \U0001F3AE️commands; \U0001F6E0️tools) or is a consolidated-framework-crate module file. If so, STOP — do not inline, do not delete the split file. --- EXCLUSIONS 2 (amended 2026-08-05, ticket 26/08/05/UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE): before inlining ANY file — Rust or otherwise — into a parent entry file, also check whether it sits under a `\U0001F9F1️elements/<Element>/` co-location directory anywhere under `\U0001F9F0️framework/**` (e.g. `\U0001F5B1️ui/\U0001F9F1️elements/Select/\U0001F7E6️component.tsx`, `…/\U0001F9CA️component.rs`), or is a `\U0001F4E6️index.tsx` re-export barrel / `\U0001F4E6️lib.rs` #[path] wiring file under a `\U0001F4E6️packages/<lang>/\U0001F3AF️targets/<target>/` or `\U0001F4E6️packages/<lang>/` package dir. If so, STOP — do not inline, do not delete the split file, regardless of language. The historical playbook in .cursor/plans/single_file_consolidation_bdb40556.plan.md is NOT applicable to any of these paths; running it there has already caused two prior regressions of an unrelated crate-consolidation restructure. Full context and the taxonomy validator that enforces this at `verify gate`: master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/\U0001F4CB️master.md, section \"Single-File-Repo hazard ruling\", and 26/08/05/UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE/\U0001F4CB️master.md for the TS-side extension."
  status: open
  title: Single File Repo
